tiger._how: Camera sets imported from Tiger with --tiger, keyed by the first 8 characters of the workout id (printed by build_dataset as tiger/<id>). Assign person and split here BEFORE looking at the set's outcomes; unlisted sets stay unassigned and are not used.

rejected._rule: A clip is excluded when the counter detects fewer than 75% of the reps performed (title count or on-screen counter): missing reps would corrupt the timing sequence. Clips with cuts, several people or non-continuous sets are excluded too.
